messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync: HelioForge reserved pool go-live scheduled Tue 09:30PT. Need final quota, autoscale policy, and load-test window by EOD.

sam_ops: copy. billing requested 10 GPU-equivalents reserved + 3 burst slots.

priya_se: customer will shift ~70% traffic initially. target p95 <=120ms, we can tolerate up to 220ms first 24h.

maria_cs: Plan A: hit 120ms; Plan B: fallback to hosted routes if regressions. Need priming budget and load commands.

 tim_infra: Autoscale proposal: min=2 pods, steady=5, max=14, burst=3. scale-up when gpu_util >=70% for 40s. scale-down after 4m idle.

devon_reliability: Recommend KV cache prefill (top 75 prefixes) and kernel warmers. Also enable ingress token-throttling to avoid thundering.

sam_ops: Priming job: 25M tokens over 3h across pool; cost est ~$2.1k on reserved pricing.

maria_cs: Sam paste the load test snippet.

sam_ops: loadgen snippet:
```bash
docker run --rm helio-loadgen:latest \n  --target https://dedicated.helio.redwood/v1/generate \n  --concurrency 50 \n  --rate 40 \n  --duration 2h \n  --prompt-set /data/helio_top_prompts.json
```

devon_reliability: Test phases: smoke 5m @10rps; peak replay 15m at 120% profile; soak 2h at target 35rps. Watch p95, 5xx/429, queue length, token burn.

maria_cs: Owners: sam_ops -> run tests & upload logs; tim_infra -> autoscale hooks & quotas; devon_reliability -> alerts & fallback; priya_se -> customer comms & rollback.

sam_ops: running staging smoke at 16:00 PT, prod-dryrun at 18:00 if green.

priya_se: sending enablement note and feedback form to Helio SREs: https://forms.redwood/helioforge-go-live-feedback

maria_cs: Risk: renewal in 3w. if SLAs slip week1 it affects negotiation. Plan: 48h canary + automated fallback to hosted for affected routes.

devon_reliability: Fallback trigger: p95>300ms for >10m OR error rate>2%. Action: route to hosted-model variant. Runbook ready.

sam_ops: deploy-bot start smoke now.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] loadgen smoke job submitted to cluster helio-loadgen-prod-9, job id=lg-20240628-902.

maria_cs: paste smoke results when ready.

sam_ops: smoke complete: 0 errors, p95=118ms, 429=0. proceeding to prod-dryrun at 18:00. Logs -> s3://redwood-ops/helioforge/loadtests/lg-20240628-902/

priya_se: looping in AE and CSM with results and runbook. capturing post-flip slack alias for Helio SREs.

maria_cs: thanks team :tada:
